violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses.--In-use utensil Ice scoops were not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface All reach-in-coolers were not cleaned as frequently as required.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned as frequently as required.
Toilet facilities. — --Men's and Women's Toilet rooms were not provided with a self closing door.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities Floor in kitchen area were not not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.
